_comment: WHAT IS THIS FILE? package.json is the 'manifest' of your project. It tells Node.js (the JavaScript runtime) three things: (1) what your project is called, (2) what external libraries (packages) your project needs to run, and (3) what shortcut commands you can run (like 'npm run dev' to start the development server). WHY DOES IT EXIST? Every JavaScript/TypeScript project needs this file. When you run 'npm install', npm reads this file and downloads all the listed packages into the node_modules/ folder.
